Czerka Corporation is a massive, galaxy spanning corporate entity which engages in all manner of business, especially anything to do with war. They are highly controversial, especially as many of their major holdings are in space now controlled by the Sith Empire. While this has received some attention by the Republic Senate, Czerka has not received sanctions for continued business there, assuring the galaxy they are careful to comply with all sanctions on Darth Malaks empire and do not supply enemy forces.

Czerka has a sizable security force, the Czerka Ranger Corps. Private security, mercenaries and bounty hunters flock to it, eager for the generous pay Czerka employees are known to receive. It works well for them, so long as they remember - dont cross Czerka, and "no questions asked" means "no questions asked."

In Veles, these Czerka Rangers are largely responsible for maintaining law and order in the colony, and they toe a careful line between enforcing company policy while ensuring that any resentment amongst the colonists does not grow out of control. In some ways, the Czerka Rangers of Veles therefore need to be almost as much diplomats and friendly beat cops as much as soldiers.

A B78 energy dampener was a type of energy dampener manufactured by Czerka Arms.

Highly versatile, chemical load grenades could be used for many different purposes. Each carrying a specific type of chemical within, their contents ranged from lethal Fex-M3 nerve gas to plank gas, an airborne chemical which broke down mechanical objects. Some types were reusable and could carry multiple payloads.

The CZR-9001 blaster rifle was a model of blaster rifle manufactured by Czerka Corporation available during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Specific blasters were often designed for specific roles in combat.

ZX miniature flame projector.

 The ZX miniature flame projector (also called a flamethrower gauntlet) was a personal, concealed, portable incendiary weapon produced by Czerka Corporation.

When triggered, the ZX produced a cone of fire five meters long and one meter in diameter. A corded fuel line connected to a backpack canister which held enough fuel for three minutes of operation . The flamethrower itself was powered by a source not located on the wrist.

Czerka MK-01 Hold Out blaster.

"They'll never see it comming. Always shoot first."
The Adjudicator was a small palm-sized hold-out slugthrower pistol manufactured by Czerka Arms.

An Adventurer slugthrower rifle was a projectile rifle with great accuracy over long distances, and is manufactured by Czerka Arms. The weapon can be easily dismantled for ease of transport. Unlike most other weapons, it shoots a solid projectile.
The CZR-9001 assault cannon was a model of assault cannon manufactured by Czerka Corporation available during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The M9 "Boomer" heavy pistol, also known colloquially as the "hand cannon," was a model of slugthrower pistol manufactured by Czerka Arms. It was designed to cram as much killing power as possible into as small a package as possible, and became a standout in the heavy pistol market. The weapon was thick and squat with a large caliber and sold for one thousand credits.

Instead of the standard rounds, the M9 fired fin-stabilized grenades from a box magazine, giving the user respectable anti-personnel capabilities at a medium range. The weapon's downsides included a limited payload, poor accuracy and cumbersome handling. It was used by engineers from both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
The CZ-22 Flametongue was the Czerka Arms version of the Model C-22 flame carbine.
The 6-2Aug2 hunting rifle was a model of slugthrower rifle present in multiple homesteads on backwater worlds in the Outer Rim Territories such as Tatooine, Viscara, and Saleucami.

The 411 was a hold-out blaster manufactured by Czerka Arms. They cost three hundred credits, and weighed half a kilogram. The 411 was fitted with a tighter emitter muzzle for a longer range than standard hold-out blasters, reaching a range of twelve meters. However, the emitter reduced the damage dealt by the blaster.
The Czerka T-3 was a type of hold-out blaster manufactured by Czerka Arms.
